lines: Just as we started running towards the mansion, my feet got caught in the ground.
All of a sudden, the hard earth had transformed into a swamp.
My upper body lost balance, and I stumbled forward and collapsed.
However, it wasn't like this sort of development was entirely unexpected.
Placing both hands on the ground, I deliberately rolled forward, and used the momentum from that to quickly stand up.
「I'm fine. But watch out. It's a twofold trap, anticipating our movements. The ground having turned to mud is unmistakably the work of a mud user.」
At the spot Hebiko pointed to, the ground, which had turned into a swamp, was bubbling.
「Gufufufufu. The captain of the Independent Commando Unit is just a greenhorn in the end!」
What had appeared was a giant, over two metres in height. A bald old man with a prominently protruding belly.
「Hey there, my student friends. How's it going?」
He spoke to us in a manner that sounded like he knew us well, but
Nobody knew him. It was the first time we'd seen his face.
「I'm Numazu!!! Did you forget the proficient custodian of Gosha, you ingrates?!」
The man shouted, making his face bright red.
Hebiko and I vaguely remembered him, but it looked like our two senpais didn't at all.
「Hey, ya damn brats!! Don't you even remember the face of the custodian who's always working for the Academy?!」
「I don't like things that aren't cute. So, I'd forget a dirty, mud-covered man like you the instant I saw him.」
「That's going a bit too far, isn't it?」
However, if I remembered rightly, he was usually in a tracksuit, and his bald head was hidden by a cap. It was completely different from right now.
But looking closely, though his upper body may have been naked, his lower half was still in that tracksuit.
And, he was wearing boots and steel tekkou. Was that his mud user getup? That was weird.
「I'll make you regret angering me, Numazu Hikoshirou-sama!!!」
「Wait, wait!! The old man's the serial killer?」
「Who knows? But I can't forgive you!!」
「That's right! This is my uncle's house! My beloved uncle's!!」
「I see. So that's what it is......」
That the owner of this residence, Yamakuro, had died after getting caught up in the battle between the Fuuma and the Igawa.
I was only a kid back then, but that didn't change the fact that I was head of the Fuuma.
Not to mention that, for a relative of someone who had been killed in that battle, even me being alive was probably unforgivable.
「Then, Janitor-san isn't connected to the serial killer?」
「As Koro-senpai says. That old man's related to the case.」
「There's no doubt that Fuuma-kun's presence changed the situation, though.」
It was just as my senpais expected.
That wasn't a happy situation for me at all.
「Gufufufufufufu. Chitchat's over, brats! I'll teach you the power of a custodian!!」
Just like in the afternoon, mud golems appeared one after another.
The will-o'-the-wisps from the magical trap were approaching us as well.
On Nao-senpai's signal, we all took combat stances at once.
